plugins.name: drata-grc-skills
plugins.description: Drata GRC skills over the Drata MCP — 17 job-to-be-done skills plus a built-in help index (drata-help) spanning audit readiness, controls, evidence, risk, third-party/vendor risk, workforce compliance, and stakeholder reporting. Every skill is named for the job: report to see it, identify-gaps to find what needs work, resolve-gaps to change it.
